svg.title: NET-10-E — Empty session browser
svg.desc: Successful zero-row read; no-selection reason line blank, Join selected disabled. Compact upper Refresh focused: production bottom-left (710, 518), 112 by 24 logical px, right edge 822, 8 px above header top 510; 2 px outer focus leaves 6 px clearance from header and title strip at 550. Status retains its left origin with at least 8 px clearance from Refresh focus. Forward focus: Refresh, table, Previous, Next, Join selected, Direct connect, Back, Refresh; reverse reverses this cycle, skipping hidden or disabled controls. Approximate top-left diagram outside the exact footer; UX-NET-10-008 owns Refresh geometry. UX-NET-10-012 owns one footer row: Join selected (28,68), Direct connect (296,68), Back (564,68), each 252 by 32 logical px in production bottom-left coordinates, with 16 px gaps. SVG footer translates these bounds to canvas origin (25,20). Former second row empty. Table, selected details, reserved paging, eligibility and feedback unchanged. Retained five-column heading strip above an empty white body with one complete noninteractive status line. Production colors: UX-NET-10-011.

g.text: No active sessions listed. You can host a session or connect directly.
LAN-first. A listing does not guarantee reachability.
Retained five-column heading strip; empty white body with one full noninteractive status line.
Join selected disabled. Refresh focused. Direct connect remains independent.
No rows, body dividers, scrollbar, selection, hover, or focus. Colors: UX-NET-10-011.
Status and paging allocations stay reserved; hide paging if neither direction exists.
